summary: Vision Marine Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report under the 1934 Act by a Canadian foreign private issuer, covering standard disclosures on convertible notes, warrants, preferred shares, and related party transactions. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. The report is purely financial and operational, with no actionable event-driven catalyst identified.
